claim_object.confidence_semantics: Argument support on a finite 0-to-1 scale; not forecast probability or accuracy.
claim_object.material_rule: Every emitted claim object is material=true and can affect the research interpretation.
claim_object.lineage_rule: Every material claim has nonempty snapshot-scoped evidence_ids except the exact generic directional abstention.

allowed_text: Insufficient evidence to form a case.
No evidence-supported case can be made.

validation.direct_fact: DIRECT support, compatible evidence family, no interpretive framing, and conservative token support in cited structured evidence.
validation.interpretation: DERIVED, INTERPRETIVE, or MIXED support; explicit interpretive wording; all material premises cited.
validation.forecast_interpretation: Must include FORECAST evidence and remain explicitly interpretive.
validation.comparison: Must cite at least two evidence families and use DERIVED or MIXED support.
validation.numbers: Exact value, unit, currency where applicable, and semantic field category for Bull, Bear, and Risk.
validation.failure_policy: Reject before publication/cache; retain sanitized attempt diagnostic and bounded retry decision.

ledger.rejection_diagnostics: Sanitized claim hash/type/support/evidence/reason only; no chain-of-thought.

orchestrator: Deterministic dispatcher/aggregator only; preserves specialist reports and lineage and creates no financial claim.
dashboard: Backward-compatible display adapter accepts v1 strings and v2 claim objects without redesign.
